content.value: The hydraulic cylinder shown in the figure has a $^ 2$ in bore and is to operate at a pressure of 1500 psi with the clevis mount shown, the piston rod should be sized as a column with both ends rounded for any plane of buckling. The rod is to be made of force AISI 1030 steel.
i) Using $n _ { d } = 2 . 5 $ select a preferred size for the rod diameter if the column length is 50 in.
ii)Find the size of the rod for a column length of 16 in.
